Analysis lives in the scripts next to this file (`plots_*.py`, `build_page.py`), which read `results/*.json`
and write the figures under `results/`. Narrative: `README.md`; chronology: `log.md`.

```{python}
import json
m = json.load(open("metrics.json"))
{T: (m["rung1"][T]["optimizer_nrmse"], m["rung1"][T]["calculix_nrmse"], m["rung1"][T]["tolerance"]) for T in m["rung1"]}
```
